parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for reporting this—I'm sorry for the impact on your team’s daily planning. Based on your note, the analytics dashboard regressed after the last release from under 5 seconds to ~30–45 seconds (and it eventually loads).

We’ve escalated this to our engineering team for investigation as a potential post-release performance regression. To help us pinpoint what changed and compare behavior, could you share the following?
1) The release identifier: version number and (if possible) the release date/time when you first noticed the slowdown, plus rollout scope (all users vs specific environment).
2) Scope of impact: does it affect all users, or only particular users/locations (e.g., office vs VPN)?
3) Consistency: is the 30–45 seconds typical every time, or does it vary by time of day?
4) Any observable errors/warnings during the slow load (copy/paste from the browser console or any on-screen messages).
5) Approximate time-to-first-content/load measurement method: are you timing in the browser, or using server logs/analytics?

Once we have the above, we’ll align on the affected environment(s) and start correlating the slowdown with the release changes and recent telemetry.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to the engineering team for investigation as a potential post-release performance regression.
Review the details you provide to correlate the slowdown with the release changes and available telemetry.
safety_notes: Do not promise a fix or refund; human review is required and resolution time is not stated.

Avoid claiming root cause or security determination.
